text: Implemented explicit raw/scaled conversion policies, typed raw dtype preservation, loss-aware Float conversion, exact Long label reads/writes, direct decode into one Ravel-owned output buffer, regular time/frequency axis recovery, unknown-temporal-unit policy, qform/sform selection policy, disagreement diagnostics, and original-header sidecars. Removed the ambiguous readScalar and preferredAffine surfaces. Shared semantic court executes on JVM and Scala.js and covers 30 endian x dtype x scaling fixtures, raw/scaled checksums, Float32/Float64 and Int32 precision boundaries, overflow, exact/fractional/nonfinite/out-of-Long label cases, exact label write policy, seconds/milliseconds/microseconds/unknown time axes, and qform/sform/fallback/agreement/disagreement/override cases. Physical JVM and Node suites retain single/pair/gzip/extensions and now add raw, exact labels, and recovered time coordinates. NIfTI courts pass 29 JVM and 12 Scala.js/Node tests; optimized Scala.js link passes. Full non-locus court passes 257 JVM/Scala.js test executions with the representation allocation guard unchanged.
